items.html: *The matter of the times of Ibur (see our explanation of them, for there is an aspect of interiority and of exteriority, and what I found here by way of a variant I have written): and this is the matter — the secret of the Ibur of nine months is to make Mochin for ZA, so that he may be able to procreate. Therefore the VAK of AA were bound with the GAR HBD in AA himself, which are actual Mochin, and through this Mochin were made for ZA in the aspect of an Ibur of nine months. And this Ibur of nine months is for the sake of the externality of ZA, and he will bring forth the aspect of worlds.
